primary_reference.title: Suppression of Cross-Polarization of the Microstrip Integrated Balun-Fed Printed Dipole Antenna
primary_reference.authors: Huang Jingjian, Zhang Xiaofa, Xie Shaoyi, Wu Weiwei, Yuan Naichang
primary_reference.journal: International Journal of Antennas and Propagation
primary_reference.evidence: Published 10 GHz geometry; measured improved unit reports more than 40 percent bandwidth and cross-polarization below -35 dB.

topology_reference.title: Equivalent-Circuit Analysis of a Broadband Printed Dipole With Adjusted Integrated Balun and an Array for Base Station Applications
topology_reference.authors: RongLin Li, Terence Wu, Bo Pan, Kyutae Lim, Joy Laskar, Manos M. Tentzeris
topology_reference.journal: IEEE Transactions on Antennas and Propagation
topology_reference.evidence: Author-hosted paper explicitly shows the backside slotline/dipole metallization and the front-side U-shaped microstrip feed plus open stub.

array_corroboration_reference.title: Bendable Wideband 4 x 4 Dipole Array at X-Band With Adaptive Beamformer for Wide Angle Wireless Sensing
array_corroboration_reference.authors: Gong Chen, Jiahao Wang, Koen Mouthaan
array_corroboration_reference.evidence: Measured X-band 4 x 4 grounded printed-dipole array using printed baluns and parasitic dipoles.

provenance.interpretation_limit: The primary paper specifies the conventional 10 GHz dimensions but its public text does not tabulate the backside ground-panel width or every launch/reference-plane detail. The v1.47 reconstruction implements the published microstrip/slotline topology and freezes missing CAD quantities as explicitly reconstructed parameters. It does not claim to reproduce the later measured slotted-cavity improvement.

geometry.back_slotline_ground_width_basis: Reconstructed from the published broad ground-panel topology; not a tabulated Huang et al. dimension.
